versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the structured-life-review skill using the LREF methodology.
- Provides a framework for guiding reminiscence across situational, sensory, emotional, and meaning dimensions.
- Includes guidelines for prompting, question style, and conversational flow focused on concrete memory anchors.
- Advises on when to use the skill, reading the LREF guide, and best practices for output and narrative use.
- Includes a note to pair with emotional-safety-fuse for sensitive topics; no emotional safety protocols are built in.
